<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Take a Picture|id=A0005}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Asking strangers for a favor can be pretty difficult for the less extrovert of us—even in our native language. But with a few Lojban words it's actually not that hard as Liliana and JP show us in this lesson. The keyphrase is '''tomar una foto''' – to take a picture.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0008|A0008: How do you say ...?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0019|A0019: How do you spell beige?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0122|A0122: Telephone card]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¡Señorita!'''
| Miss!
| '''¿Sí?'''
| Yes?
| '''¡Disculpe! ¿Nos podría tomar una foto por favor?'''
| Excuse me, could you please take a picture for us?
| '''¿Cómo no? ¡Sonrían!'''
| Of course./How could I not? Smile!
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thanks.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¡Señorita!'''
| Miss!
| '''¿Sí?'''
| Yes?
| '''¡Disculpe! ¿Nos podría tomar una foto por favor?'''
| Excuse me, could you please take a picture for us?
| '''¿Cómo no? ¡Sonrían!'''
| Of course./How could I not? Smile!
| '''Gracias.'''
| Thanks.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Miss! | '''¡Señorita!'''
| Yes? |  '''¿Sí?'''
| Excuse me! Could you take a photo for us, please? (formal) | '''¡Disculpe! ¿Nos podría tomar una foto por favor?'''
| Of course! Smile! (formal) | '''¿Cómo no? ¡Sonrían!'''
| Thanks. | '''Gracias.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Miss! | '''¡Señorita!'''
| Yes? |  '''¿Sí?'''
| Excuse me! Could you take a photo for us, please? (formal) | '''¡Disculpe! ¿Nos podría tomar una foto por favor?'''
| Of course! Smile! (formal) | '''¿Cómo no? ¡Sonrían!'''
| Thanks. | '''Gracias.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Sir! Excuse me! | '''¡Señor! ¡Disculpe!'''
| Yes? | '''¿Sí?'''
| Could you take a picture for us? | '''¿Nos podría tomar una foto?'''
| No! | '''¡No!'''
| Sir, please! | '''Señor, ¡por favor!'''
| Yes, of course.  | '''Sí, ¿cómo no?'''
| Thanks! | '''Gracias!'''
| Sir, miss, smile. | '''Señor, señorita, sonrían.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Sir! Excuse me! | '''¡Señor! ¡Disculpe!'''
| Yes? | '''¿Sí?'''
| Could you take a picture for us? | '''¿Nos podría tomar una foto?'''
| No! | '''¡No!'''
| Sir, please! | '''Señor, ¡por favor!'''
| Yes, of course.  | '''Sí, ¿cómo no?'''
| Thanks! | '''Gracias!'''
| Sir, miss, smile. | '''Señor, señorita, sonrían.'''
}}</includeonly>
